title: 2 months of progress on my game
author: TheGrowthYardGaming
selftext:
Recently I shared my game here and some other places and opened up multiplayer for testing. I got some of the best feedback ever and it really changed my perspective on what I am building and the direction to take it.

  
This is day 1 vs day 52. The next update should be really impressive and I am excited to keep working. Even this video doesn't capture some of the updates I have added to the live site. Anyways just sharing my progress so far. Really enjoy building with Claude Code.

comments.author: WhiteBlackBlueGreen
comments.body: The game looks cool but ngl I hate the way this video is edited from the flashes to the sounds. Try experimenting with some fade effects to show the progress in a less jarring way

replies.author: TheGrowthYardGaming
replies.body:
Thanks this great feedback haha. I am managing a full time job and building this game with what free time I have. So the marketing hasn't been given the justice it needs. I will dedicate a day to working on videos and content to share when I get to a better place in the games dev.

Truth is Opus 5.5 put this clip together entirely. I normally edit in Premiere Pro on longer video's but I let it generate this.

replies.body:
